correctness.rationale: Any still-eligible edge has not rung: its endpoints have always been vacant and would have accepted the edge at an earlier arrival. Conditional on the explored past its residual clock is exponential, so at a state with r eligible edges the next success is uniform among them after an independent Exp(r) holding time. The terminal vacancies form an independent set of even size; independence number three leaves only zero or two, with the pair in distance class two or three. The finite exact recurrences and uniform edge-order matching argument then give the stated outcomes. Time is the absorption time, and along each transition the number of eligible edges strictly decreases; the triangular equations consequently produce pure exponentials rather than resonant polynomial terms. Independently authored exact code reproduced 1,720 masks, all terminal fractions and the common probabilities for each distance class, all 17 coefficients, the mean 167225267/144471600, and all five individual weight classes over 125 perfect matchings. The CDF has constant coefficient one and vanishes at zero; the weighted matching totals recover the perfect-coverage mass.
residual_risks: Exact for exchangeable tie-free order as to terminal outcomes, and specifically independent rate-one exponentials as to the displayed time law. Heterogeneous rates, desorption and a thermodynamic limit are not addressed.

value.rationale: The icosahedron is a canonical finite, symmetric, triangular substrate outside the usual high-girth regular benchmark. The law resolves how dynamics bias two geometrically distinct vacancy types and even individual perfect matchings with the same coverage, and gives an exact transient absorption benchmark rather than just a count or an average. Distinguishing matching weights is necessary for checking any claim that greedy perfect coverage samples a uniform matching. These are motivated finite observables requiring the concrete graph calculation.
residual_risks: The significance is as a complete exact finite-network benchmark, not a claim about all polyhedra, triangulated graphs or physical surfaces.
